admission.justification: Confusing requested reading tools with runtime grants could give an investigating role write or lifecycle authority it never received.

applicability: Requested tools in the canonical Investigator capsule.
conditions: The canonical manifest and the wording test name the same retained request list.
Runtime authority is independently admitted; a provider concern is read through retained evidence routes, and provider state change belongs to its owning leaf Worker.
exclusions: Requests do not authorize writes or enlarge another role’s requested tool set.

evidence: test_role_instruction_wording.py exact fourteen requests; .capsule-matrix.json unchanged other-role tools

statement: The Investigator capsule requests the retained context, source, knowledge, task-status and role-message interfaces; no retired provider or code-search operation is requested, and requested tools grant no additional runtime mutation authority.
